candidates.findings: Hand-coloured steel engraved map 'Van Diemen's Island or Tasmania' in the John Tallis decorative style, with a Greek key border, a top vignette view (Hobart Town and Mount Wellington), a lower left vignette of buildings, a lower right vignette of a thylacine-like animal, and a coin inset. This matches the c.1851 Tallis/Rapkin map. At this resolution it cannot be confirmed whether it is an original 1850s engraving or a later facsimile. The paper tone and the light colouring look consistent with an original.
candidates.condition: Clean and evenly toned, no obvious tears. Framed under glass with a red mount. Not examined out of the frame.
candidates.rescore_note: Tallis Tasmania map, original worth a few hundred but facsimile risk

candidates.title: HANDWOVEN SACRED IKAT TEXTILE ...
candidates.reason: Iban pua kumbu with figurative motifs; an older genuine one has a real collector market, but the date claim needs checking
candidates.findings: Framed red ground ikat textile with paired human figures and hooked spiral motifs, fringed. A typed label on the mount reads 'PAU KUMBIE (sic), A TRADITIONAL HANDWOVEN SACRED CEREMONIAL IKAT TEXTILE MADE BY THE IBAN PEOPLE SARWAK (sic), BORNEO. 19TH CENTURY ASIAN.' This is an Iban pua kumbu fragment or panel. The 19th-century date is the seller's claim; the bright clean red and white palette could also suit a 20th-century piece.
candidates.condition: Framed and mounted. Fringe intact on at least one end, colours bright, no visible holes.
candidates.rescore_note: Iban pua kumbu panel, framed, 19th century date doubtful
